message.content: {"hts_code": "9026.20.8080", "reason": "The ZTR AxleGen is an electronic speed/rotation sensing device measuring the rotational speed of locomotive axles and wheels, classified under Chapter 90 instruments for measuring or checking rotational speed (9026 Instruments for measuring or checking the flow, level, pressure or other variables of liquids or gases) as a speed measuring instrument, with the residual 'other' subheading for other instruments and apparatus for measuring or checking variables of liquids or gases."}
